about.label: ABOUT
intro: I am a full Stack Developer with 8 years of professional experience. Native Spanish speaker with a C1 level of English.

I work as part of a 15-person development team and occasionally step in as coordinator when the main lead is unavailable. I serve as the architect and maintainer of ElasticSearch clusters, as well as a developer of custom Kibana plugins used to analyze large transactional datasets. I also lead the design and development of new features across our platform.
Currently seeking new opportunities in international teams, with a strong interest in expanding my skills in cybersecurity and AI/ML.
